title: ZikrFlow
description: A community dhikr-tracking app for the global Muslim community - tap counters, public/private rooms, streaks, and global/country/room leaderboards, with full offline support. Flutter + Firebase, with a Next.js admin panel. Live on Google Play.

title: BhashaVoice
description: Open-source, self-hostable voice-cloning platform - clone a voice from a short recording, then generate speech in Bangla or English from the same voice, with no re-cloning. Includes a dataset pipeline, a CLI, a REST API, and fine-tuning workflows for both the IndicF5 and Chatterbox engines.

title: QueryPlayground
description: Practice real PostgreSQL and MongoDB queries entirely in the browser - no signup, no server. PostgreSQL 17 compiles to WebAssembly via PGlite; MongoDB queries run client-side via mingo. Includes a schema explorer, query history, and an optional BYOK AI assistant.

title: ZeroShutter
description: A privacy-first image editor that runs entirely in the browser - crop, resize, color adjustments, watermarking, and batch export to ZIP, with automatic EXIF stripping on export. No uploads, no servers, no tracking.
